body: The Long Beach Community Investment Company - Special Meeting
minutes_text:
THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 5, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Hilda Delgado, Vice Chair  Eva Melgarejo, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Alejandra Ramirez, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director  Elwood Sides, Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

CALL TO ORDER

At 4:00 PM, Vice Chair Delgado called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Chambers, Melgarejo, Ramirez, Delgado

  Commissioners Absent: Esparza, Sides

Also present: Christopher Koontz, President, Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, Richard Anthony,
Principal Deputy City Attorney, Silvia Medina, Housing Development Officer, Elizabeth Weithers,
Housing Operations Officer, Margaret Madden, Neighborhood Improvement Officer, Kjell Stava,
Real Estate Project Coordinator, Nikki Amick, Community Program Specialist V, Kate Schiffman,
Community Program Specialist III, Monica Jaime, Secretary.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Director Melgarejo.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53634  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  A motion was made by Director Ramirez, seconded by Director Chambers, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Chambers, Melgarejo, Ramirez, Delgado
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Esparza, Sides

  Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, spoke; and provided the President’s Report.

  2024-2025 Action Plan; accept public comment and recommend City Council
  approval. (Citywide)

  A motion was made by Director Chambers, seconded by Director Ramirez, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Chambers, Melgarejo, Ramirez, Delgado
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Esparza, Sides

  Director Melgarejo spoke.

  Vice Chair Delgado spoke.

  Access and Demolition Contract with Linc Housing Corporation for additional costs
  associated with the demolition of 4151 E. Fountain Street; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary
  to implement the agreement.

  Authorize the President to negotiate a Second Amendment to the Affordable
